This template lets you use <pre>this style</pre> with wiki markup and has other cool features take more work without a template.

==Features==
* You can include up to 19 vertical bars (<code>|</code>) '''without''' using the <nowiki>{{!}}</nowiki> template. If you feel like it you can add more (if you know how), but they might be deleted if a new version is copied over.
* Overflowing text wraps!

==Examples==

<pre>{{pre|'''Bold text''' ''Italics'' <s>strikethrough</s>}}</pre>
{{pre|'''Bold text''' ''Italics'' <s>strikethrough</s>}}
----
<pre>{{pre|blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah}}</pre>

{{pre|blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah}}
----
<pre>{{pre|'''{{tc|#f0f|Bold, magenta text}}''' is useful for getting someone's attention.}}</pre>
{{pre|'''{{tc|#f0f|Bold, magenta text}}''' is useful for getting someone's attention.}}
